data.description:
## Description

**What**: Symmetric to the SC1 producer-contract story but for the two impl-plan producers. Extend dso:approach-proposer (Step 2) and dso:task-decomposer (Steps 4 and 6) with the same optional remediation_context input, DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration (token shared per the shared-protocol doc), pre-generation Read gate quoting evidence from each reviewer-artifact path, and delta-only emission that preserves prior tasks/AC not named in findings. Model directive remains opus on each.

**Why**: SC2 — impl-plan Steps 2/4/6 currently produce inline remediation drafts; both producers must honor the same contract before the caller-side wiring can land.

**Scope**:
- IN: Agent definition changes to plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md and plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- IN: Producer-side fixtures for both agents (DELTA OUTPUT declaration, evidence quotes, prior-AC preservation, backward-compat)
- OUT: Caller-side Steps 2/4/6 dispatch wiring (delivered by SC2 caller-wiring story)

## Done Definitions

- When dso:approach-proposer is invoked with a remediation_context, its output begins with a DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration (token sourced from the shared-protocol doc) and contains an evidence quote from each reviewer-artifact path before any approach draft
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When dso:task-decomposer is invoked with a remediation_context, its output begins with a DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration (token sourced from the shared-protocol doc) and contains an evidence quote from each reviewer-artifact path before any task draft
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Delta-mode task-decomposer output preserves prior tasks and AC items that are not named in any finding (no silent drop of unrelated prior work) and preserves the existing TDD task structure (RED-before-GREEN, depends_on chain) for modified entries
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When either agent is invoked without a remediation_context, output shape is unchanged from current behavior
  ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Consistency] DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration token MUST match the one defined in the SC4 shared-protocol doc and used by the SC1 producer-contract story so the caller-side parser is shared.
- [Risk] Task-decomposer delta-mode must not regress the existing TDD task structure (RED-before-GREEN, depends_on chain) — preserve the original schema in modified entries.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an implementation-plan orchestrator, I want dso:approach-proposer and dso:task-decomposer to accept a remediation_context and emit delta-only output gated by an evidence-quote Read step
